entries.message: Site Controls replace the page actions menu on iPhone and iPad, as a sheet that rises from the bottom edge or a popover in a wide iPad window.
Touch and hold an action in Edit to drag it into, along or out of the row on top of Site Controls.
A site's permission request waits in Site Controls, which open on their own and close once you answer.
Copy Page Title, Save Tab and Open in Private Browsing are in the command palette on iPhone and iPad.
